summary: Six independent non-P0 fronts advanced: queued-child traversal identity, hostile traversal regression, durable traversal skill/owner delta, pre-strip title semantic safety, accessible provenance Warm Wall, and Regnet/Venice/execution evidence. Snapshot certification was re-proven as an exact owner boundary rather than falsely promoted.

fronts.name: queued child traversal identity
fronts.change: Persistent redirector/type/device/inode drift between child admission and pre-scan observation now has a fail-closed portable source policy, hostile fixtures, doctrine and corrected existing-owner delta.
fronts.boundary: Existing owner wiring NO. Swap-and-restore, identity reuse and replacement after revalidation remain atomicity-open.

fronts.name: skill-title pre-normalization semantic safety
fronts.change: H1 admission now has supporting source that observes decoded raw-line controls before broad strip can erase them, while preserving legitimate Unicode composition and sharing the same exact title contract with folder fallback.
fronts.boundary: Existing owner still uses line.strip(); corrected delta is PROPOSED_NOT_APPLIED.

fronts.name: snapshot certification
fronts.boundary: Exact owner readback still publishes discovered skillCount/skills even when snapshot is UNSTABLE or expected-head mismatches. Supporting certification policy/patch exist, owner wiring NO. Preserved rather than green-painted.

fronts.name: accessible provenance Warm Wall
fronts.change: Existing source organism now exposes queued-child change, unstable snapshot, expected-head mismatch, pre-strip title rejection and atomicity-open states with native radio controls, focus visibility, >=48px touch intent, non-color tokens, inline SVG and reduced-motion handling.
fronts.boundary: SOURCE ONLY; no Android render, TalkBack runtime, deployment or phone delivery claim.

fronts.name: Regnet/Venice
fronts.change: Code-first review repaired two self-created defects before completion and keeps every owner/test/runtime boundary explicit.

fronts.name: execution evidence
fronts.change: Fresh automatic workflow conclusions were bound to the exact reviewed source head without manual retry or stale-cause reuse.
